<div id="efdf91b2-f6c6-4470-aaaa-b2009cd9ef65" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h2><span class="font-weight-bold">Lost Power?</span></h2>

<p>If you have lost power in your property, follow the steps below to see why you lost power and <strong>how to restore it.</strong></p>

      </div>
</div>

    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="layout layout--twocol-section layout--twocol-section--50-50 container">

          <div class="layout__region layout__region--first">
        
<div id="36422db3-9cb5-4566-82ed-6a033296a91f" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 1: Do you have credit? </span></h3>

<p>You may have lost power because you ran out of Top Up. Find out how to <a href="/support/topping-support/meter-balance"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">check your balance here</span></span></a>. If you have run out of Top Up Credit, <a href="/support/topping-support/how-top"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">find out how to Top Up here</span></span></a>.        </p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="9641e3fe-dca1-4816-88e7-45a6d57e756c" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 2: Local Issue? </span></h3>

<p>Check with your neighbours to see if they have power. There <strong>might be an outage in your area</strong>. If they don't have power as well, you'll need to <strong>check with ESBN</strong>. </p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="ef95752f-64b0-437a-b5a6-cee6cab57d61" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 3: Power Outage in Area? </span></h3>

<p>Check online with ESB Networks for <a href="https://www.esb.ie/esb-networks/powercheck/"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">power outages in your area</span></span></a>. Check for <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/apps/faultlogging/CheckStatus#/"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">specific issue with your property</span></span></a> using your MPRN number here. </p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="ad28c276-10f2-45b5-93bd-1b7fc52f5e58" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 4: Reset your meter: </span></h3><p>If you have a Smart Pay Meter, <strong>press B, A, B</strong> on your Meter to see if that restores power. If you have a Classic Pay Meter, <strong>press and hold the '0' button</strong> directly on the Meter to see if that restores power. <a href="/support/classic-pay-v-smart-pay"><span class="font-weight-bold text-pp-pink">Find out if you have a Classic Pay or Smart Pay meter here</span>.</a></p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="bb812d5e-cea8-446f-ad69-946cf998b701" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 5: Fuse Board: </span></h3>

<p>Is there a problem with fuse board? Are all <strong>fuses in the 'On' position</strong>? The switch should be <strong>facing upwards</strong>. There will also be a main fuse on your board, make sure this switch is facing upwards. Do you smell any burning around the fuse board? This could be a sign that a <strong>fuse has blown and needs replacing</strong>.</p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="e75c804b-8877-4a96-a420-e9be20c54ec8" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 6: ESBN Meter: </span></h3>

<p>Check the <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/existing-connection/meters-readings/how-to-read-your-meter"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">ESB Networks (ESBN) meter</span></span></a>, usually located in a box outside, to make electricity is coming into your property. If you have an ESBN Smart meter, and there is no display, you should <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/tns/contact-us/general-queries"><span class="font-weight-bold"><span class="text-pp-pink">Contact ESB Networks</span></span></a>. If you have an older meter with a spinning dial, check to see if it is turning. If it is turning slowly or not turning at all, there could be an issue with your fuse board and/or with ESBN. </p>

      </div>
</div>

<div id="53b712b4-58d8-477a-9a0b-29d29b332451" class="basic-block">
  <div class="container">
    
        
            <h3><span class="font-weight-bold">Step 7: Overload Protection: </span></h3>

<p>If you live in an apartment or a new house you may have an <strong>Overload Protection Devic<span class="font-weight-bold">e</span>,</strong> located near your ESBN meter. If there has been power surge/outage in your area, this can 'trip', turning off electricity to your property. There will be one switch on an Overload Protection Device, which <strong>should be in an upwards position</strong>.</p>

      </div>
</div>

      </div>

Our Cookies
We use cookies, which are small text files, to improve your experience on our website, show you personalised content, show you personalised ads that are relevant to you, to limit the number of ads you see from us and help with our marketing efforts.  Click “Accept All Cookies” to continue to our website or click on settings, to manage them individually.
Learn how Prepay Power and our partners collect and use data in our Cookie Policy
Cookies Settings
Accept All Cookies
Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More information
Allow All
Manage Consent Preferences
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details‎
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details‎
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details‎
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details‎
Intercom Cookies
Intercom Cookies
These cookies may be set through by Intercom. If you do not allow these cookies, you will be unable to use Intercom live chat to speak with Prepay Power.
Cookies Details‎

refundable on recovery of meter and keypad
